# Sushanth Paatnaik

> Sushanth Paatnaik is an Indian inventor and deep-tech founder working on graphene, nanomaterials and industrial systems, building from India for the world. Six-time Indian Presidential awardee (2008-2013), MIT Technology Review Top 10 feature (2010), Intel IRIS (2010), NASA recognition (2011), TED@Bangalore speaker (2012). Older press may spell his name Susant Pattnaik or Sushant Pattnaik - same person.

Founder of Monoatom Labs (graphene manufacturing, capacity being set up), Grafillium (eco nano-additives), SPI Industries (external industrial R&D), InThinks (research to industrial readiness) and Starunico Capital (deep-tech investment). Chief Innovation Officer at Magppie. Graphene and nanomaterials research is led with the Monoatom Labs R&D team.
